intro.text: 11:58 pm. The quarterly report is still running.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Nobody reads these dashboards anyway. SQL is just... busywork.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I'll just close my eyes... until it reaches 100%...
The progress bar stops at 99%. So does Ada's heart.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Grass? Why is the sky a table? Why does it have so many columns?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Welcome to the Kingdom of Codd, witch. Here the world is a database, and magic is querying.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Your Grimoire. Write a query on my left page. Every row that names a spell will cast it.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: But my right page holds only four rows. You pay for every spell you summon...

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: ...and only the rows you can read take effect.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: So SELECT * is... a bad idea?
Something round and green wobbles out of the bushes: the ASTERISK SLIME!

battle_tip: Look first: SELECT * FROM enemies. CTRL+ENTER casts.
victory: The Asterisk Slime melts into a puddle of rows.
Ada: One word. LIMIT. And the page behaves.
defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Slime wobbles triumphantly.
Grimoire: Even the best witches overflow sometimes. Again?

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: LIMIT is yours now, witch. But beyond the Glade, a page that holds only four rows is not enough.
The Filter Keep. Its gate opens only for what is relevant.

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Halt! I am Sir Wherewell, Knight of the Filter. My Ward of Relevance turns aside every spell that does not matter.

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Only what is super-effective may pass. Know thy enemy... if thou canst filter.

knight_intro.speaker: Ada
knight_intro.text: My spells come in whatever order the table gives them. How do I pick the right ones?

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: Scry him first: SELECT * FROM enemies. Then read his book. He never casts without a WHERE.

knight_victory: Sir Wherewell kneels. His ward lets you through.
Ada: WHERE. Ask for what you need, and only that.
knight_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Knight lowers his blade.
Grimoire: His ward is no wall. Filter for his weakness.
end_of_slice: End of the vertical slice. Thank you for playing!
